configuration: verification/ideal_2D_oce with the input.geom overlay, which changes only data.gmredi and data.diagnostics: the same 1x56x15 idealised zonally averaged global ocean restarted from the same pre-c54 pickup at iteration 36000, the same wind and surface-temperature relaxation, the same three time steps, the same CD scheme, the same seventh-order flux-limited advection, the same frozen salinity and the same ivdc_kappa=100, but the eddy transfer coefficient now comes from the GEOMETRIC closure compiled in through GM_GEOM_VARIABLE_K in the experiment's GMREDI_OPTIONS.h and switched on with GM_useGEOM=.TRUE.: a prognostic depth-integrated eddy kinetic energy is stepped forward with a generation term from the eddy flux, a linear dissipation at GEOM_lmbda=1.16e-7 per second (a hundred-day timescale), horizontal diffusion at GEOM_diffKh_EKE=500 and an advective and a westward wave-propagation term, and the coefficient is GEOM_alpha=0.08 times that energy divided by the depth-integrated Eady growth rate, bounded between GEOM_minval_K=50 and GEOM_maxval_K=2e4 and given a vertical structure function (GEOM_vert_struc=.TRUE.); the Visbeck coefficient is not set in this overlay and therefore defaults to zero, so this deck and the primary one exercise genuinely different production paths; the eddy energy starts uniform at GEOM_ini_EKE=10 because there is no pickup_gmredi file to restart it from (pkg/gmredi/gmredi_read_pickup.F says so in the log and pkg/gmredi/gmredi_init_varia.F sets it); the window is 10 steps of 86400 s, ten days, half the upstream twenty, chosen so that the overlay's 864000 s oceDiag average with GM_GEOMK and GEOMstru closes exactly on the final iteration and is graded. The -864000 s surfDiag snapshot with the six GEOM energy diagnostics is not graded: pkg/diagnostics/diagnostics_write.F evaluates a snapshot stream at myTime - deltaTClock and writes it under an earlier iteration's suffix (measured natively on 2026-09-05: an 11-step run writes surfDiag.0000036005 and oceDiag.0000036010 against a final state at 36011, so lengthening the window would grade neither), and no window makes it carry the final iteration.. Graded: every <field>.<final iteration>.data written by the end-of-run state dump (the prognostic fields of write_state.F and of the packages in use), read with the shape and precision of the .meta sidecar; the initial-state dump and the log are not graded.
observable: every graded field of the final state dump after 10 steps (T and the other prognostic and package fields written at the final iteration), all cells
default_vs_upstream: nTimeSteps 10 (upstream 20); dumpFreq, pChkptFreq, chkptFreq 0 with dumpInitAndLast; writeBinaryPrec 64; useSingleCpuIO; useSingleCpuIO=.TRUE. in data
variant: ic/variant is ic/nominal with GEOM_alpha=0.08000000000000003 in data.gmredi instead of 0.08, replacing the deck's own line: two ulps of the graded precision (3.5e-16 relative) on a parameter that enters the tendency from the first step, verified to be a distinct double, so the two runs differ at round-off level without leaving the round-off floor; the recorded spread is the check's real sensitivity under this rule.

warrant: The observable is every cell of every prognostic field in the final state dump, compared as |c - r| <= 1e-10 + 1e-08|r|; the relative part is the working bound because the graded fields span many orders of magnitude, the absolute part covers cells at or near zero. The observable is every cell of the final state dump plus the oceDiag average that closes on the final iteration, which carries the GEOMETRIC coefficient GM_GEOMK and its vertical structure GEOMstru; the eddy energy, its five tendency terms and the first mode speed live in the surfDiag snapshot, which is not graded, so they are seen through the coefficient they produce and the tracers it moves. The relative bound with an absolute floor is physical because the closure has a genuine equilibrium in which generation, dissipation and transport balance, so the coefficient it returns is fixed by GEOM_alpha, GEOM_lmbda and the resolved buoyancy field, and every fault above moves it by parts in a hundred or more. It is achievable for the same reasons as the primary deck: the domain is two-dimensional in latitude and depth so baroclinic instability cannot be resolved, the experiment's CPP_EEOPTIONS.h defines CG2D_SINGLECPU_SUM so the barotropic global sum is done in a fixed order on one processor, the upstream log records the solver converging in exactly 27 iterations at every step, and the flux limiter of the advection scheme is continuous. The extra amplification relative to the Visbeck deck is the prognostic energy, which remembers a perturbation instead of re-diagnosing it; ten days is under one dissipation timescale of a hundred days, so the memory is real but the damping has barely acted, and this is the argument that most needs a measurement to confirm. The switch that made an earlier survey want to exclude this experiment is ivdc_kappa=100 combined with deltaTtracer=86400: model/src/calc_ivdc.F sets a cell's vertical diffusivity to 100 m2/s wherever a strict sign test on the vertical density gradient says the column is unstable, and 1e-5 otherwise, so a flipped cell changes its diffusivity by seven orders of magnitude for a whole simulated day. On closer reading that switch is far less dangerous here than it looks, and the reason is worth stating precisely. This deck sets sBeta=0 and saltStepping=.FALSE., so density is a function of temperature alone and temperature is the only tracer the jumping diffusivity acts on. The implicit vertical flux it produces is proportional to the very temperature gradient whose sign decides the switch, so at the switching point the extra flux is zero: the tendency is continuous across the branch even though the coefficient is not, and a cell that flips under a two-ulp perturbation gains a flux of order the perturbation rather than of order 100 times the background. That is the opposite of the situation in the MLAdjust decks, where salinity is stepped as a passive spice tracer and can carry a finite vertical gradient across a neutral temperature interface. The window is nevertheless halved relative to the upstream twenty steps, to ten days, because the argument bounds the size of the jump and not its accumulation, and because a run restarted at equilibrium spends its time near neutrality in the convecting high latitudes. A native scan of the worst relative spread against window length at 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20 steps must be run before the bound is fixed: smooth growth means ten steps is comfortable, isolated cells with O(1) differences would mean the argument above is wrong somewhere and the window must go to five steps or fewer, at the cost of the two diagnostics files. The variant perturbs GEOM_alpha, which the overlay writes explicitly and which multiplies the eddy energy in every water column from the first step, when the energy is still at its uniform initial value of 10. The one way it could be blinded is the lower bound GEOM_minval_K=50: if the coefficient sits on that floor everywhere, GEOM_alpha has no effect at all and the measured spread would be exactly zero. The fallback in that case is GEOM_lmbda=1.16e-7, which enters the energy equation itself and is therefore upstream of every clamp, and after that GM_background_K=10, which the overlay also sets and which is added to the coefficient in every wet cell. Faults: GEOMETRIC carries a prognostic variable, so an error compounds instead of being re-diagnosed each step, and the coefficient it produces is graded directly through oceDiag. A ten percent error in the dissipation rate GEOM_lmbda changes the equilibrium eddy energy by ten percent within a few dissipation times and the graded GM_GEOMK field by parts in 1e-1 well inside ten days. Dropping the generation term, which is the eddy flux acting on the mean buoyancy gradient, leaves the energy decaying exponentially from its uniform initial value, and GM_GEOMK with it: an O(1) difference. Dropping the westward wave-propagation term changes the meridional distribution of the energy, and of GM_GEOMK, by tens of percent at mid latitudes. Omitting the vertical structure function makes the coefficient depth-independent and changes GEOMstru by O(1) and the residual overturning by parts in 1e-2. A ten percent error in GEOM_alpha changes the coefficient by ten percent everywhere it is not clamped and the temperature field by parts in 1e-3. A single-precision energy equation leaves relative errors near 1e-7 in the graded energy after ten steps. The expensive path under test is pkg/gmredi/gmredi_calc_geom.F, which forms the Eady growth rate and the first baroclinic mode speed, builds the two-dimensional GEOMETRIC coefficient, extends it in the vertical with the structure function and then steps the eddy-energy equation with its generation, dissipation, advection, wave and Laplacian terms, feeding pkg/gmredi/gmredi_calc_tensor.F and gmredi_calc_psi_bolus.F and the transports of gmredi_xtransport.F, gmredi_ytransport.F and gmredi_rtransport.F; the rest of the step is the same seventh-order advection, CD-scheme momentum, model/src/calc_ivdc.F and model/src/impldiff.F as the primary deck.. The nominal-versus-variant spread recorded by selfcheck is the measurement of the round-off amplification under this exact rule, and the bound is finalised against it with the human.
